_about: Reconstructed triggers for puzzle streets whose Collision-triggered Event Boxes, quoins, switches and keys were never archived (rules: public/js/puzzle-triggers.js, feature: public/js/features/puzzles-feature.js). Screen space like street.boxes: bottom-centre x, y, then w, h. Each trigger's `why` records how its position was derived (street geometry, the decos/platforms its events toggle, and the reference video). Quoin counts are the street's source Coin (quoin) objrefs; their types follow the video where it shows them.

GHVOD0F3T403694.name: Griinolyza
GHVOD0F3T403694.blurb: Four hidden bridges with a gap that runs back and forth. Time your jumps.

reward.source: quests/puzzle_level_color_blockage.js (Color Unblocking), the shipped quest built from these colour levels

GHVOD0F3T403694.completion: Every board crossed. A little colour suits you.

triggers.why: Ledge end before bridge 1 (plat 3529 ends x=556; the bridge's five boards 3557-3561 start x=675). check_challenge1 must set its flag before default_challenge1 (flag_not_exit) shows the boards and seq1_gap1 starts the 850 ms gap that runs B1-B5-B1. Video VxAyiFj2gVU 0:07: the bridge appears as the avatar reaches the ledge.
Ledge end before bridge 2 (plat 3588 ends x=1558; boards 3564... start x=1692). check_challenge2 clears challenge1 (stopping its chain) and hides bridge 1 behind the player.

show_coin/hide_coin fade ug_wall_heights_1338418528030 (layer T_1335489691386, same size as the middleground, x=2918 y=131, 157x91): the cover over the alcove at the top of the ladder (x=2925, y 8-270) between walls 7088 (x=2854) and 7089 (x=2994).

Ledge end before bridge 3 (plat 3616 ends x=3109; boards start x=3247). seq3_plat1_on starts the two high boards (3941/318 and 4082/265) blinking 2.8 s on, 1.2 s off: the route to the bonus quoins above the bridge.

Upper ledge end before bridge 4 (plats 9988-9992 end x=4666 at y≈318; the two six-board halves sit at y=319). seq4_plat1_on blinks the middle board 1105 (x=5507) and the two high boards 2 s on, 0.8 s off: the only way across the hole between the halves (video VxAyiFj2gVU 0:45-0:55).

GHVDKQ2O6S23LVJ.name: Amberlyza
GHVDKQ2O6S23LVJ.blurb: Sinking islands over the water, see-saw rocks and falling pillars on the way to the door.

reward.source: quests/puzzle_level_color_blockage.js (Color Unblocking), the shipped quest built from these colour levels

GHVDKQ2O6S23LVJ.completion: Islands crossed, rocks tipped, pillars ridden. Very amber of you.
GHVDKQ2O6S23LVJ.eventsWhy: The source unhide_secret1_a/b/c scripts can never run: each clears its own flag and then exits unless that flag is set (flag_clear then flag_not_exit), and nothing sets secret1_*. Repaired to the evident intent: the pulse dot lights the low rope's charm, standing on each rope stone lights the next, and the third reveals the top stone (plat 0623, pc_perm 0 in the source).

triggers.why: pulseDot_1341884449719 (layer T_1341884449718, x=1334 y=402), the glowing dot unhide_secret1_a hides: it sits on the low cap (plat 8231, y≈421) beside bling_charms_3.
Rope stone a: plat 0624 (x 1033-1061, y 262) under bling_charms_4_1340664170610 (x=1047), the charm unhide_secret1_a lights.
Rope stone b: plat 0622 (x 843-873, y 200) under bling_charms_4_1340407775205 (x=859); lights the top rope and reveals plat 0623 (x 657-681, y 160).

sink1_a switches plat 9182 (x 2366-2486, y 330, the island's top) off and the next one 20 px lower on: the box is the island's own top. Six 500 ms steps lower it 120 px to the water (y≈450); 700 ms later it pops back. Video YvRCmwdipuo 0:40-0:55.

Island top plat 0473 (x 3881-3938, y 338), the last before the right ladder.

The pool between walls 9170 (x=2237) and the right ladder (x≈4040): floor y≈655, surface just under the sunk islands (y≈450-460). swim is the street's own jetpack physics (gravity x0.3, jump x0.4, speed x0.6); walk resets it.
See-saw 1 left arm: plat 680 (x 4621-4678) / 673 (x 4632-4678). Stepping on an arm tips it down (tilt1_left_action swaps 673/674 for 680/681).
Arch rock 3 left foot: plat 574 (x 5162-5203, y 257-238). Only one foot is solid at a time; the box is tall so a jump onto the other foot catches it.
Arch rock 3 right foot: plat 576 (x 5238-5279).
Arch rock 4 right: plats 617/618 (x 5493-5554, y 263-285).
Pillar 1 cap: plat 6611 (x 5670-5727, y 241), the one fall1_a switches off. The cap then drops 20 px every 400 ms (12 steps, to y≈481) and returns 4 s later.
Pillar 2 cap: plat 6612 (x 5869-5919, y 205); fall3_a runs 14 steps.
Pillar 3 cap: plat 6613 (x 6052-6118, y 244). Not bound: bounce1-3, whose replacement plats 1340661292646-648 are missing from the geometry (they would drop the avatar through the cap).
